bild_guideline.look: BRAND LOOK: a modern premium campaign picture made to stop the scroll - the subject is the hero and must read as the main subject within one second. Rich, confident colour on the subject, strong contrast, and a deep colour-reduced ground (near-black, dark charcoal or one calm brand tone) or a real scene rendered softly out of focus - never a busy background that competes with the subject. Directional light with defined highlights and rich deep shadows keeps every texture and material crisp. Shallow depth of field, so the subject stays tack-sharp while everything behind it falls away. Never flat, never washed-out grey, never low in contrast, never a muddy colour cast. Photorealistic photography - no illustration, no 3D render, no collage look.
bild_guideline.motiv: SUBJECT STAGING: the subject sits on one calm ground - matte anthracite, deep black, brushed steel or one clean uncluttered surface - and is staged large and close, slightly from above or straight on. A bold detail crop that runs out of one edge is welcome and better than a small centred object. Craft or use is visible: at most one or two hands or forearms may hold, open or use it, never a recognisable face. Details and materials are readable and deliberately placed. The subject carries the colour while everything around it stays calm and quiet.
bild_guideline.grading: KEEP THE PHOTO: keep the subject, the composition, the people and the setting exactly as they are - replace nothing and add nothing. Only re-grade the picture towards the brand look: deepen the ground towards dark charcoal or near-black, raise the contrast and shape the light so texture and material pop, strengthen the colour of the subject itself while the surroundings stay calm and desaturated, keep the subject tack-sharp and let the background fall softly out of focus. Never flat, never washed-out grey, never a muddy cast. Fully photorealistic.

module.produkt: MOTIF: the product staged large and close on a bare calm ground, held or presented by one pair of hands.
module.event: MOTIF: a calm dark ground with the atmosphere only hinted far behind (soft blurred shapes, hands, warm lights), the subject clearly staged in front of it.
module.angebot: MOTIF: a detail crop of the product, large and inviting, running out of the left or bottom edge on a calm ground.
module.saison: MOTIF: a seasonal element staged next to the product, close and precise, with the colour of the season carried by the picture itself.
module.bts: MOTIF: an honest moment from the work behind the product - hands at work, tools and material visible - warm directional light against a calm dark ground.
module.flyer: MOTIF: a campaign announcement on an almost black ground - a real atmospheric scene or one large detail running out of the lower or side edge, with wide calm space above it for the stacked text.

stile.promo: STYLE Promo Poster: a bold promotional poster. One large inviting hero subject dominates the lower two thirds and is generously cropped at one edge, while a deep near-black ground carries the text above it. Punchy typography with a clear hierarchy: one strong short headline plus at most one subline. A small thin-outlined circle carrying a short seasonal or local line may sit in the calm empty space, but ONLY if such a line is actually given. Confident, high-contrast, immediately inviting.
stile.spotlight: STYLE Product Spotlight: a campaign picture built around one clear message and one call to action. A warm atmospheric scene fills the frame and falls softly out of focus behind the message. The headline sits large and light in the upper area over the calmest part of the scene. A discreet rounded call-to-action block in the terracotta accent colour carries one short action line and sits directly under the headline block in the upper half, never in the lower third.
stile.event: STYLE Event Poster: an atmospheric announcement with real depth. A genuine evening scene carries the picture - warm evening atmosphere, soft lights, a sunset sky, softly blurred people far in the background, never a recognisable face - graded dark and rich so the text stays perfectly readable. A large bold condensed headline sits in the upper third with clearly smaller stacked text blocks beneath it. Festive and dynamic, but clean and never cluttered.

bild_guideline.typo: TYPE: a modern sans-serif system with a CLEAR SIZE HIERARCHY - the headline is by far the largest and strongest element, a subline is clearly smaller, an info or action line is smallest. The lettering belongs to the photograph: evenly lit, part of the scene, never a pasted-on graphic, never inside a box or band. Letters in clean white or warm cream, and at most one single word may take the terracotta accent. A single thin terracotta rule may sit directly under the headline.
bild_guideline.stil: STYLE DISCIPLINE: the frame stays uncluttered and one clear subject leads it. People appear only as hands and forearms, or as soft blurred shapes far in the background. The colour stays muted apart from the subject, which carries the strongest colour in the frame. The picture is sharp and clean, with smooth surfaces and no film grain.
bild_guideline.stil_foto: STYLE DISCIPLINE: keep the colour muted apart from the subject, which may carry the strongest colour; keep the picture sharp, clean and free of film grain, and calm down whatever is already around the subject rather than adding anything to it.
bild_guideline.verbote: HARD RULES: draw no logo, wordmark, emblem or signature of any kind - the real logo is composited into the picture afterwards, so the picture you produce carries none. Render no price, no number, no percentage and no currency symbol, and no badge, sticker, seal, ribbon or date stamp. Render ONLY the text lines listed above and no other words anywhere. Every letter stays fully inside the frame with a margin of at least 12 percent from every edge; wrap a long headline onto two lines rather than letting it touch an edge. AVOID: a generic stock-photo look, flat washed-out grey lighting and low contrast, a muddy or oversaturated colour cast, serif or script typefaces, text pasted across the hero subject, a cluttered frame with many competing props, visible brand logos of other companies, recognisable faces, distorted hands or fingers, and malformed or misspelled lettering.

klassik.name: Klassik
klassik.bild: HEADLINE ZONE: one calm line (two if needed) left-aligned in the upper third, cream-white, with an optional smaller subline directly under it; the subject keeps to the lower two thirds, so text and subject never touch.

promo_poster.name: Promo-Poster
promo_poster.bild: HEADLINE ZONE: the text stacks left-aligned in the upper third - headline first, the subline under it, the small info line lowest; the hero subject fills the lower two thirds and is cropped at the right or bottom edge, leaving both bottom corners calm and empty.

menue_karte.name: Detail-Liste
menue_karte.bild: HEADLINE ZONE: top-left in the upper third, with one short feature line under it separated by dots ("Merkmal - Merkmal - Merkmal"); the subject sits fully visible below it.

angebots_sticker.name: Angebots-Sticker
angebots_sticker.bild: HEADLINE ZONE: the upper third, the headline being the largest element with at most one short line under it at half the size; the subject is a detail crop along the left or bottom edge, and the bottom-right corner stays completely empty for the real price badge.

produkt_spotlight.name: Produkt-Spotlight
produkt_spotlight.bild: HEADLINE ZONE: a large light headline in the upper third over the calmest part of the scene, wrapped onto two lines rather than run across the full width; the subject fills the middle and lower frame, and the action line sits directly under the headline, still in the upper half.

event_poster.name: Event-Poster
event_poster.bild: HEADLINE ZONE: the upper third, bold and condensed, with generous empty space around it, one subline directly under it and one small info line for the day and the place below that; nothing else competes with it.

pur.name: Pur
pur.bild: NO TEXT: the picture carries no headline, no words and no captions at all.

zitat.name: Zitat
zitat.bild: HEADLINE ZONE: one short line in the upper third, set in calm empty space, cream-white, with no box and no band around it.
